QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Tearful Reunion
QuestInfo.0: Eremos could probably use a friend to talk to right about now.
QuestInfo.1: Eremos is clearly upset over his disagreement with Surana and her subsequent departure. But finally, Surana returns! The two are clearly overjoyed to see each other and both make a concerted effort to patch things up.
